title: Writing / Glossary / Definitions
slide_intent: Define related product terms distinctly so readers can understand the learning structure and available services.
strategic_value: A shared vocabulary from courses through exercises can help Duolingo explain its product without inconsistent labels.
demonstration: A tall two-column glossary pairs fifteen terms with definitions, including product names, learning units, XP, streaks and supporting services.
practical_value: Use the historical definitions to study naming relationships; verify current product structure before reusing factual descriptions.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place Definitions and the permission to reuse or consult the entries at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack term-definition rows at right, retaining the progression from company and subscription to learning units and related services.

reference_purposes.Application: The page supplies reusable definitions for fifteen terms.
reference_purposes.Constraint: It specifies capitalized Duolingo in print, learners rather than users, and XP rather than points.

ingredient.name: Shared product vocabulary
ingredient.application: Use agreed term meanings and the preferred learner and XP labels.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. Historical quantities, service durations, subscription benefits and course structure are source-period statements, not verified current facts.
